game.title: Penguin's Heartlight Rescue
game.description: Guide a cheerful penguin to gather hearts and restore six colors to a winter aurora.

assets.altText: Round black-and-white penguin with a rainbow striped scarf, based on the first supplied coloring page.
The same penguin with festive rainbow scarf details, based on the second supplied coloring page.
The same penguin with a blue striped scarf, based on the third supplied coloring page.
Soft rising chime when a heart is caught.

text.content:
A little warmth.
A whole sky of color.

controls.hint: Tap anywhere to guide the penguin
